paragraphs: I am a Software Engineering undergraduate passionate about building modern, scalable, and user-centered software solutions. I specialize in exploring full-stack and mobile development, combining strong problem-solving skills with clean architecture and thoughtful user experiences.

I enjoy transforming ideas into functional digital products through efficient coding practices, continuous learning, and the use of emerging technologies. I am driven by curiosity, innovation, and the goal of creating software that delivers meaningful real-world impact.

cards.title: Goals
cards.content: To grow as a professional software engineer by developing high-quality, scalable applications, contributing to innovative projects, and creating technology-driven solutions that improve everyday experiences.

cards.title: Education
cards.institution: Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology (SLIIT)
cards.program: BSc (Hons) in Information Technology Specializing in Software Engineering.

cards.title: Technical Focus
cards.label: Full-Stack & Mobile Development
cards.content: Building responsive web interfaces and cross-platform mobile apps. Focused on modular architectures, backend API design, relational/non-relational database design, and structured state management.
